{{Top|leg}}
'''Victor Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] that participated in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="Black Boxes, White Ice">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Black Boxes, White Ice|Hoth}}</ref> in [[3665 BBY]].<ref name="Gnost">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref> The squadron took down dozens of [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] battlecruisers before they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] over [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].<ref name="Black Boxes, White Ice" />
